lane: lab H115 (2026-10-27): H102 story build, ONE change = hook at 0.0 s is a spoken + on-screen question ("What do you say instead of very nervous?"); first better word on screen by 2 s. Tier-1 word never used on the channel.

card.headline: What do you say instead of *"very nervous"?*

beats.speech: What do you say instead of very nervous?

card.headline: Anxious
card.use: Mia is waiting for her job interview.

beats.speech: Anxious: Mia is waiting for her job interview. She feels anxious.
Jittery: Her hands start to shake. She feels jittery.
On edge: Her heart is pounding. She feels on edge.
Which word will you use? Comment yours!

language_approval.notes: Replaced Relieved (antonym-like, not a synonym of very nervous) with On edge (Cambridge: nervous and unable to relax) + Her heart is pounding. Beat 2 use: Mia waits -> Mia is waiting (scene-setting progressive). Hook/end/Jittery lines natural. Caps OK. Policy: clean. pic-3 not yet generated: must show tense waiting, not a smile.
